description: Two coloured neon rims either side of the subject, their hues the world's neonHue split by hueSplit (magenta and teal at the defaults), plus a low cool fill that lights the subject only. The world's own practicals (street lamps, windows, neon bars) are left as they are. The night-street light: keyAzimuthDeg sets how far behind the subject the rims sit.
